figures.shows: Two boxes with the stored contact points and the current relative pose: a move inside the recycle distance keeps the old points, and a stale point past the edge of the lower box shows the price
figures.caption: The old contact point stays where it was computed, so after the upper box slides past the edge, a point still seems to hold it up.
figures.alt: A side view of a small box on a larger box. A dot marks the contact point computed earlier. The upper box has moved sideways by a few centimetres and now overhangs the edge, while the dot still lies under it, past the lower box's edge.
